vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: devops-journey
Version: 2.0.0

The skill is a simple DevOps activity logging toolkit that records timestamped entries to local log files in ~/.local/share/devops-journey/. Analysis of scripts/script.sh and SKILL.md reveals no evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or harmful prompt injection. While the script contains logic bugs (duplicate case labels in the bash script make the actual data export and health check functions unreachable), these are unintentional flaws rather than malicious features.

llm.summary: The skill appears to implement a local journaling/tracking tool consistent with its description, but there are small inconsistencies between the documentation and the code (notably an advertised env var that the script does not honor and a few implementation bugs), so proceed with caution.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the included script: both describe a local DevOps learning tracker that writes timestamped entries to per-command .log files in a data directory. The capabilities requested (none) are proportional to this purpose. Minor inconsistency: SKILL.md header uses a different repository/name string (90Daysofdevops) but functionality is still aligned.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md claims you can override the data directory with DEVOPS_JOURNEY_DIR, but the shipped script hardcodes DATA_DIR to "${HOME}/.local/share/devops-journey" and does not read DEVOPS_JOURNEY_DIR. That mismatch may lead to surprising file placement. The script otherwise only reads/writes files under the data directory and does not access other system paths, network, or credentials.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec is provided (instruction-only plus a single script); nothing is downloaded or installed by the skill package itself, which minimizes installer risk.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required credentials or config paths. SKILL.md suggests DEVOPS_JOURNEY_DIR can be set, but the script ignores that variable and uses HOME; this is an inconsistency rather than a credential risk. The script uses only HOME and standard Unix utilities.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request permanent platform privileges (always:false) and does not modify other skills or system-wide settings. It persists data in a per-user folder under the home directory, which is appropriate for a journaling tool.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is a simple local journaling tool that writes logs to ~/.local/share/devops-journey by default and does not require network access or credentials. Before installing: (1) be aware the SKILL.md says you can set DEVOPS_JOURNEY_DIR to change the data directory, but the script does not honor that—so logs will go to your home directory unless you modify the script; (2) the script contains a few small bugs (e.g., JSON export formatting) that may produce invalid exports; (3) check the data directory contents if you care about privacy, since history.log and many .log files will be created and appended to; (4) if you want a different storage location, either modify the script to respect DEVOPS_JOURNEY_DIR or wrap it with a small launcher. Overall the functionality is coherent with its stated purpose, but the documentation/code mismatch and export bugs justify caution.
